references.text: The description of the holy garments to be made for Aaron and his sons for priestly service.
Detailed instructions about the garments for Aaron's sons for priestly service.
Aaron and his sons are clothed in the priestly garments during the consecration ceremony.
Reiteration of the command to make woven garments and holy garments for Aaron and his sons.
Fulfillment of the command: the woven garments and the holy garments were made.
Summary of the finished garments for priestly service in the sanctuary.
Moses clothes Aaron in the priestly garments during the consecration.
Moses clothes Aaron's sons in their priestly garments.
Aaron's priestly garments are transferred to his son Eleazar.
Expands the meaning of the garments for Aaron's sons to apply to an eternal succession in the priesthood.
Connects the making of the garments with the ritual dressing that makes the priest holy for service.
Specifies the individual parts of the holy garments mentioned collectively in the source verse.
Complements the garments with the anointing necessary for Aaron and his sons to perform priestly service.
Describes the actual clothing of Aaron with the holy garments as a fulfillment of earlier commands.
Clarifies the installation ritual by specifying the dressing (belt and turban) as part of the holy garments.
